hooks.name: Grader wording check
hooks.description: Checks grader page text against the wording rules

action.prompt: The file just saved holds visitor-facing text. Check it for: British spellings (colour, neighbour, licence, centre, organise, favourite), the word "YP" as a whole word, a dollar sign followed by digits, and the word "guarantee". Fix any you find. Do not touch anything else.
